desc: Statically trace iBoot/XNU -> SPTM GXF/SPRR domain establishment and the NVMe CoastGuard/SART handoff using pinned paired firmware and the asahi_neo model. Determine whether any supported loader transition can retain or acquire the XNU-authorized domain after handoff. Produce a proof/no-go table; no target access, no raw BAR read, no GENTER execution.
